text:
katie: Heads-up — after the 2.7.1 rollout we hit a p95 latency spike ~600ms (baseline ~220ms) and error-rate for text-gen up ~2.8% (was 0.1%). Rolling window started ~10:22 UTC. Deploy-bot showed 42% rolled.

deploy-bot: rollout_update: canary->prod 42% complete. latency_p95=610ms (+180%), errors=2.8% (>alert). Action: notify channel.

mike (sre): seeing increased queuing on GPU worker pools, KV cache miss rate jumped. stack traces show OOMs in runtime kernel selection path.

sanjay (infra): is this isolated to a model variant? logs show model xlm-7b-quant had most errors. routing sent ~30% to that variant during rollout.

katie: can we pin traffic away from xlm-7b-quant and continue? prefer to avoid full rollback if safe.

ops-oncall: authority check — per playbook, oncall + release lead can decide to rollback. I'm oncall, but need eng lead to ok.

amelia (pm): customer impact? No paid customers impacted yet; error spike affects internal tests and a few dev keys.

mike (sre): pinning traffic away to fallback model (xlm-7b-int8) is possible via routing API: PATCH /rollout/traffic { "xlm-7b-quant": 0, "xlm-7b-int8": 1 }. I can run in ~5m.

katie: do it. before that, freeze release notes and pause further merges. @sanjay help with canary cutoff.

sanjay (infra): applying traffic slice now. exec logs: `PATCH /rollout/traffic -> 200 OK` — traffic shifted. p95 dropping in 2m to ~240ms.

deploy-bot: rollout_update: traffic change applied by sanjay. new p95=245ms, errors=0.15%.

katie: looks good. decision: avoid full rollback, mark 2.7.1 as "partial-degrade (variant)" and pin xlm-7b-quant out. Create post-mortem and rollback runbook to reintroduce after kernel fix. I'll draft release note blurb and freeze further rollouts until patch.

ops-oncall: manual rollback not needed. I'll update #incidents and escalate to eng-runtime for kernel selection fix.

mike (sre): follow-up action: capture KV-cache metrics + kernel-selection flags and upload logs + tarball to eng-runtime. tagging: `s3://redwood-ops/incident/6424242424/`.

amelia (pm): I'll send a short customer note: "We observed a performance regression for a specific model variant in 2.7.1. We've temporarily routed traffic to a compatible variant and paused the rollout. No data loss. We'll update with a timeline."

katie: thanks team. I'll open the postmortem PR `2.7.1-variant-pin-pm` and close this thread after it's linked. :thumbsup:

mike (sre): one more — recommend adding a deploybot check to flag sudden kernel OOMs during kernel-negotiation for future rollouts.

katie: noted. assigning follow-up to eng-runtime + deploybot infra.

(ended)
